quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Update on Phase III trial of Ultomiris in adults and (07-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ultomiris HSCT-TMA programme detail beyond the call: the failed adult/adolescent ALXN1210-TMA-313 Phase III (randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled; 146 patients from 18 countries) had event-free survival through 26 weeks as its primary endpoint. The paediatric filings Alexion is advancing rest on the open-label ALXN1210-TMA-314 Phase III (41 patients from seven countries), which showed overall survival of 87.2% at 26 weeks and 73.4% at 52 weeks, plus the ALX-TMA-502 external control study (real-world data from 307 patients in 10 countries). Ultomiris holds Orphan Drug Designation in the US and Japan for HSCT-TMA and US FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for paediatric HSCT-TMA; safety across both trials was consistent with its known profile, and engagement with health authorities on next steps for the adult indication continues. The company estimates HSCT-TMA affects fewer than 6,000 people in the US.
